title: tc-run-checkpoints
description: An agent run's restore points: pick a step, see what it captured and what going back discards, and go back.

checkpoints.description: The checkpoints, oldest first – one before each step of the run

status.description: The run: "running" (a live run), "paused", "done", "failed" – always set by the app

heading.description: The run's goal, shown as the heading

selected.description: The picked checkpoint's id. Picks apply unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

elapsed.description: How long the run has gone on, in ms – the strip's length (defaults to the last checkpoint)

placeholder.description: Placeholder of the note that goes along with the restore

title.description: The step that starts at this checkpoint, e.g. "Run the test suite"

detail.description: A second, quieter line under the title

tool.description: Tool the step called, shown as a small mono chip, e.g. "run_tests"

at.description: When the checkpoint was taken, in ms from the start of the run

captured.description: What the checkpoint holds – shown when it's picked

files.description: Files the step changed – going back to it or an earlier point discards them

restorable.description: false: no snapshot was kept, so the run can't go back here

value.description: How much of it, e.g. "14 messages"
